A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quesoth]] was a member of the '''Circling''' caste, which advised the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]], ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], from where he [[Homeworld/Legends|originated]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he intercepted the [[Queen of the Red|Queen's]] [[bowlcarrier]], [[Trevik]], who carried a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for her, on the member of the [[Midli]] caste's way [[Trevik's home|home]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

The [[Circling]] brought the bowlcarrier to a nearby Midli residence, and along with Trevik's [[Trevik's family|brother]] [[Jirvin]], tasked the bowlcarrier with using a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] to record several [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] inside the [[Dwelling of Guests]] building brought there by [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]. The pair convinced the bowlcarrier to do so by telling him that if [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]&mdash;who was going to receive the recordings&mdash;was able to determine by studying the art if the Quesoth monarch was Esva's ally, instead of a tool, they would not take action against her. Trevik then left and did as asked. The Circling spoke [[Quesoth Common Speak]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Circling appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
